acceptanceCriteria: English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese homepages show the same verified complete case with reproducible input and scope, observed findings, evidence boundary, human decision, and remaining unknowns.
The first-use route explicitly separates installation, repository attach, calibration, and the first governance Work Item, with deterministic links and commands.
The example can be repeated from a source checkout or an attached repository using documented commands and placeholders; it makes no unverified time-saving, safety, or risk-interception claim.
The First Work Item pages explain how the real archived case maps from input to evidence, Outcome, human decision, and cleanup, while preserving the Runtime lifecycle and authorization boundaries.
The tri-language documentation passes the repository parity, getting-started semantic, and documentation acceptance checks once the independent active Work Item is closed.
goal: Complete the first-use and README path with a verified, reproducible case that lowers onboarding reading cost without inventing benefits or governance authority.
intent: Make a new adopter understand what to install, what attach and calibration do, how the first governance Work Item proceeds, what evidence supports the example, and which human decision remains theirs.
outOfScope: Release publishing or installation artifact changes
External participant recruitment or user research
P2 performance and Repository architecture work
